prompt: Which movie starring Meryl Streep was nominated for Best Picture at the Academy Awards the year that the Pioneer 11 visited Saturn?
answer: **Kramer vs. Kramer (1979)**. It was nominated for—and won—Best Picture at the 52nd Academy Awards, held in 1980. Pioneer 11 visited Saturn in 1979.
